title: XXI–XXIII. External and internal calling
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): External stands as that which stands as done through ye externally preached word and ye administration belonging toward ye sacraments. — It stands as external or internal. — XXI. — This can also sometimes and in a certain extraordinary mode happen without ye external word, but God's ordinary institution stands as toward join ye word with ye internal operation belonging toward ye Spirit. — Internal stands as that by which ye Holy Spirit illuminates ye mind and bends ye will, so that ye human seriously and efficaciously obeys ye external calling. — XXIII.
pass_b_english: XXI. It is external or internal. External is that which is done through the externally preached word and the administration of the sacraments.

XXIII. Internal is that by which the Holy Spirit illuminates the mind and bends the will, so that the human seriously and efficaciously obeys the external calling. This can also sometimes and in a certain extraordinary mode happen without the external word, but God's ordinary institution is to join the word with the internal operation of the Spirit.
source_text: XXI. Est externa aut interna. Externa est quae fit per verbum externe praedicatum & sacramentorum administrationem. XXIII. Interna est, qua Spiritus sanctus mentem illuminat & voluntatem flectit, ut homo vocationi externa serio & efficaciter obtemperet. Haec etiam aliquando & modo quodam extraordinario sine externo verbo fieri potest, sed ordinarium Dei institutum est verbum cum interna Spiritus operatione conjungere.
